title: signal-handoff-tracing-dashboards-2026-06-04
body:
Purpose: quick weekly handoff + run-through of tracing/dashboard cost telemetry items for the week. Informal notes from the 06/04 observability sync (30m).

Attendees: Avery (notes), Diego, Priya, Samira, Jon, Anu (on-standby).

1) Quick status snapshots
- Tracing ingestion: P50 ingest latency stable at ~220ms, small bump on 6/02 during deploy window (spike to ~380ms for 12m). Root cause likely transient GC on ingestion worker pool (OBS-612).
- Span volume: +9% week-over-week — growth concentrated on embeddings route (/v1/embeddings) after customer X beta.
- Dashboard refresh errors: intermittent 500s on dashboard-api when fetching large saved queries; surfaced by Priya (OBS-621).
- Cost telemetry: cost-per-100k-spans down 4% after sampler adjustment but tokenization overhead pushed net cost slightly up for short traces. We need finer-grained view.

2) Tracing sampling experiment (new idea & notes)
- Hypothesis: route-aware dynamic sampling (higher sample rate for low-latency critical routes, lower for high-throughput background routes) will improve signal-to-cost.
- Experiment design: run A/B for 2 weeks on 10% of traffic for dynamic sampler that uses route and latency heatmap. Compare to global static sampler baseline.
- Metrics to collect: effective tail coverage (p95/p99 spans captured of high-latency requests), cost-per-sampled-span, false-neg rate for errors.
- Owner: Diego to scaffold sampler toggle + small feature flag. PR tracked in github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/487.

3) Dashboards: compact executive view + query perf
- Request from product: compact dashboard (single page) highlighting cost-per-route, 1/3/7d trend, and top 10 traces by failed-span-rate. Samira prototyped wireframe.
- Perf problem: large saved queries (multi-join across trace indices) cause dashboard-api timeouts for >30s queries. Short-term mitigation: add query timeout + cached materialized view for top-traces (TTL 10m).
- Decision: add a new endpoint that returns pre-aggregated top-trace summaries from materialized cache. Jon to prototype cache layer (Redis-backed) and metric exposure.

4) Incident handoff notes (small GC-driven ingest spike)
- Summary: 6/02 transient spike during deploy; ingest worker pool GC pauses amplified due to a memory leak in a third-party lib used by ingestion transformer.
- Action taken: rolled back transformer change, increased worker count temporarily by 20%, enabled heap profiling for further diagnosis (OBS-612).
- Next: Diego to open a deeper profiling session and propose a patch or library update; ETA 6/10.

5) Cost telemetry gaps discovered
- Missing cost attribution on burst credits for Dedicated customers — costs were attributed to regional pool instead of customer-reserved capacity. Need to add per-customer capacity labeling at ingestion time.
- Proposed fix: add customer_id tag to cost telemetry emitted from capacity allocator; will require a short schema bump and migration for historical alignment. Priya to lead schema changelog + migration plan.

6) Short-term priorities for next 7 days
- Diego: scaffold dynamic sampler feature flag + baseline metrics (due 2026-06-11).
- Jon: spike on Redis-backed materialized top-trace cache + API shim (demo 2026-06-09).
- Priya: cost-telemetry schema migration plan + sample export to billing pipeline (draft 2026-06-08).
- Samira: wireframe for compact executive dashboard + list of saved queries to migrate to aggregates (review 2026-06-07).
- Avery: consolidate runbook updates for trace-ingest GC playbook and add heap profiling steps (done 2026-06-06).

7) Blockers / help needed
- SRE support: need transient increase in logging retention for one week to capture GC events (SRE ticket opened: SRE-2048).
- Data team: need assistance to backfill customer_id labels for 4 days of missing cost telemetry — Priya will coordinate.
- Observability infra quota: current Redis cluster at 72% memory — Jon requests approval to bump to 80% or add a small replica; sending request to infra.

8) Notes to self / loose thoughts
- Consider adding "trace-quality" score that summarizes span completeness, sampling fraction, and error-capture for each route. Could be surfaced in Optimize to trigger automatic sampler suggestions.
- Evaluate whether KV-cache hits correlate with trace count per request — might be able to drop sampling for high-KV-hit requests to save cost without losing useful signal.

Appendix: quick links referenced
- OBS-612 (ingest GC spike): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OBS-612
- OBS-621 (dashboard saved query errors): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OBS-621
- PR (dynamic sampler prototype): github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/487
- Runbooks: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OBS/Runbooks

End of notes.
